# EventGo

> EventGo is a full-stack event planning workspace for individuals and small teams.

EventGo helps planners create event themes, timelines, checklists, and visual planning boards. It includes AI-assisted ideation, a calendar, vendor booking pipeline, and export tools.

## What EventGo does

- **Theme Library** — Create and browse reusable event themes with colors, mood, activities, decor, music, food, budget, checklist, and timeline phases
- **AI Studio** — Generate full event themes from a text description using Google Gemini. Also offers event idea suggestions and planning research Q&A
- **Planner Board** — Visual ReactFlow canvas for building event planning flowcharts. Export as PNG, PDF, JSON, Markdown, or TXT
- **Notes & Calendar** — Capture planning notes with a month-view calendar showing events and notes on their dates
- **Vendor Bookings** — Track vendor status from "to contact" through "confirmed"
- **Planning Themes** — Structured planning templates with checklist, timeline, budget categories, and vendor needs

## Public pages

- `/home` — Product overview and starter themes
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy
- `/terms` — Terms of use
- `/cookies` — Cookie policy

## Authentication

EventGo uses Google OAuth (NextAuth). Authenticated users get access to the full workspace.

## Tech

Built with Next.js 14, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, ReactFlow, and Google Gemini API.
